game.title: Borderlands 4
game.blurb: Open-world looter shooter RPG from Gearbox Software, released 2025-09-12. RAWG average playtime: 101 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The main story missions and their hidden milestones. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Exploring the Regions
chapters.summary: Finding every map location in The Fadefields, Terminus Range, Carcadia Burn and Dominion City.

chapters.title: World Events, Bosses and Vaults
chapters.summary: The Goredello, Airship and Creep Impact world events, world bosses and the Primordial Vault Guardians.

chapters.title: Side Missions, Contracts and Activities
chapters.summary: Claptrap missions, every side mission, contracts and all the open-world activities.

chapters.title: Levels, Gear and Collections
chapters.summary: Player levels, Ultimate Vault Hunter levels, legendary gear, challenges, cosmetics and vehicles.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No StrategyWiki page under "Borderlands 4" or "Borderlands IV". borderlands.fandom.com answers the API with about 86 linked articles, including "Achievement (Borderlands 4)", "Borderlands 4 mission flow", "Borderlands 4 Weapons" and "Action Skills"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Steam app 1285190 is "Borderlands 4". 41 of 63 Steam achievements are hidden; they all sit in the story chapter, though many have very low unlock rates (under 3%) and are probably side missions or later content rather than story steps. RAWG lists an average playtime of 101 hours. RAWG lists PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox One as platforms.
